summary: Two climbers stranded about 200 ft below Ellingwood Ridge on La Plata Peak after going off route, unable to ascend or descend as storms approached; reported unharmed. CCSAR-N inserted teams by helicopter (REACH Air Medical Services and Canon City Helitack each flew in two team members); Helitack extracted both climbers directly from their position; all rescuers out of the field by 9 p.m.
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR North, REACH Air Medical Services, Canon City Helitack
notes: 2022-08-14 was a Sunday; article published ~2022-08-24 (UUID creation timestamp), text explicitly dates the rescue Aug. 14. No names or CORSAR card status published.
